body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 Necrotic Damage and reveal its occupied space through ordinary concealment until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: Learn whether it is sustained by a visible ordinary magical effect, without revealing secret identity or intentions.
Suppress 1 point of its ordinary magical Fortitude bonuses until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Full Manifestation - Phantom
rider.html: You may burn 3 Action Dice and spend 2 Mana to enter Phantom Full Manifestation (FM-1P). It replaces you; use its profile. Dice, Resources, Movement spent and recorded injuries do not refresh.
